metrics.notes: 50 distinct identifiable employers/companies were individually surfaced across current HH/job-board listings in Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Yekaterinburg, Kazan, Samara and Novosibirsk. Recruiters, anonymous employers, public/state/very large unsuitable companies, duplicate employer rows and roles without a sufficiently strong business-change signal were rejected at FAST GATE. Two strongest low-overlap candidates received full SIZE -> LEGAL -> SIGNAL -> LPR -> CONTACT checks and both passed. Exact INN repository search immediately before write returned no matches for either candidate. No canonical files were modified and no outreach was performed.
